cond_0001.intro: Assists the Laboratory Director and Medical Directors in managing personnel and daily operations of the Clinical Pathology Laboratory, including the Reference Laboratory, Essential Services Laboratory, Physician Office Laboratories and Patient Service Centers. Oversees both technical and non-technical Clinical Laboratory personnel and operations to ensure the highest quality of service to patients and clinicians at all times.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Supports the vision and goals of [Company name masked] and adheres to established best practices (AIDET, Rounding, thank you notes, 5/10 Rule, etc.). Recruits, selects, and manages staff to demonstrate behaviors consistent with [Company name masked] beliefs and [Company name masked] Core Values; acts as chief retention officer for area of responsibility. Works collaboratively with the Assistant Managers to ensure that meaningful leader/employee rounding is completed according to span of control expectations. Coordinates all phases of orientation and training, including technical compliance and safety in accordance with all regulatory requirements for technical team members and students. Develops, implements, and analyzes adherence to organizational and service/department specific standards of care and policies and procedures. Conducts timely staff performance appraisals ensuring staff competence while emphasizing staff retention strategies through coaching and individual development. Ensures adequate staff scheduling within the department to ensure quality patient care and meet productivity benchmarks. Maintains productivity benchmarks and looks for continuous improvement in operations and utilization of resources. Provides and encourages educational opportunities and application of those skills for technical staff. Accountable for quality of patient care, physician satisfaction and employee satisfaction; facilitates a multi-disciplinary and collaborative approach to interdepartmental problem solving. Promotes interdisciplinary and interdepartmental collaboration to optimize efficient and effective patient-centered care delivery. Ensures courteous, knowledgeable service to patients, staff, and visitors; continually updates and educates staff on appropriate patient care, client service and laboratory issues. Collaborates with laboratory management to resolve management and operational issues. Ensures staff compliance with all hospital, state, OSHA, College of American Pathologists (CAP) and AABB regulations for all facilities and supports coordination, preparation, and participation in CAP and AABB inspections for all facilities. Collaborates with laboratory leadership to ensure the performance of high complexity testing in all sections is in accordance with policies, procedures, regulatory and safety requirements. Ensures adequate and appropriate supplies are used for employee safety. Participates in and supports the departmental budgetary procedure to ensure proper operational and planning. Maintains professional growth and development through seminars, workshops, and professional affiliations to keep abreast of latest trends in personnel management and field of expertise. Participates in and/or leads meetings, committees, strategic planning and lean projects as assigned. Performs other related projects and duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor of Science or Allied Health degree
MLS(ASCP)CM certification
Five (5) years previous supervisory experience in a clinical laboratory and managerial experience in a clinical laboratory
Knowledge of clinical laboratory test protocols, equipment, and processes
Knowledge of organizational and human resource management standards and practices
Knowledge of management and leadership principles and practices
Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with all levels of personnel and medical staff
Ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams and work as a team member
Ability to problem solve and engage independent critical thinking skills
Ability to prioritize work demands and work with minimal supervision
Ability to make operational and management decisions in response to changing conditions
Ability to be available for technical issues daily and during after hours, holidays and weekends
Ability to maintain regular and punctual attendance
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree in healthcare administration, Clinical Laboratory Science or other related field
Knowledge of computer hardware equipment and software applications relevant to work functions
Ability to develop written policies and procedures, memoranda, and performance evaluations with measurable behaviors
Ability to maintain confidentiality relevant to sensitive information
Ability to perform crucial conversations with desired outcomes
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Recruit, select, and manage staff to demonstrate behaviors consistent with [Company name masked] beliefs and Core Values; take ownership as chief retention officer for your area of responsibility.
Direct Assistant Managers to ensure that meaningful leader/employee rounding is completed according to span of control expectations.
Own all phases of orientation and training, including technical compliance and safety in accordance with all regulatory requirements for technical team members and students.
Develop, implement, and drive adherence to organizational and service/department-specific standards of care, policies, and procedures.
Conduct timely staff performance appraisals, ensuring staff competence while executing staff retention strategies through coaching and individual development.
Determine adequate staff scheduling within the department to ensure quality patient care and meet productivity benchmarks.
Maintain productivity benchmarks and lead continuous improvement in operations and utilization of resources.
Provide and champion educational opportunities and application of those skills for technical staff.
Be accountable for quality of patient care, physician satisfaction, and employee satisfaction; lead a multi-disciplinary and collaborative approach to interdepartmental problem solving.
Drive interdisciplinary and interdepartmental collaboration to optimize efficient and effective patient-centered care delivery.
Ensure courteous, knowledgeable service to patients, staff, and visitors; proactively update and educate staff on appropriate patient care, client service, and laboratory issues.
Resolve management and operational issues in collaboration with laboratory management.
Ensure staff compliance with all hospital, state, OSHA, College of American Pathologists (CAP), and AABB regulations for all facilities; lead coordination, preparation, and participation in CAP and AABB inspections for all facilities.
Work with laboratory leadership to ensure the performance of high complexity testing in all sections is in accordance with policies, procedures, regulatory, and safety requirements.
Ensure adequate and appropriate supplies are used for employee safety.
Take ownership of the departmental budgetary procedure to ensure proper operational planning.
Maintain professional growth and development through seminars, workshops, and professional affiliations to stay current on trends in personnel management and field of expertise.
Lead and participate in meetings, committees, strategic planning, and lean projects as assigned.
Perform other related projects and duties as assigned.
cond_0008.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Knowledge of clinical laboratory test protocols, equipment, and processes.
Knowledge of organizational and human resource management standards and practices.
Knowledge of management and leadership principles and practices.
Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with all levels of personnel and medical staff.
Ability to problem solve and engage independent critical thinking skills.
Ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams and work as a team member.
Ability to maintain confidentiality relevant to sensitive information.
Ability to prioritize work demands and work with minimal supervision.
Ability to make operational and management decisions in response to changing conditions.
Ability to be available for technical issues daily and during after hours, holidays, and weekends.
Ability to maintain regular and punctual attendance.
Bachelor of Science or Allied Health degree.
Five (5) years previous supervisory experience in a clinical laboratory and managerial experience in a clinical laboratory.
MLS(ASCP)CM certification.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of computer hardware equipment and software applications relevant to work functions.
Ability to develop written policies and procedures, memoranda, and performance evaluations with measurable behaviors.
Ability to perform crucial conversations with desired outcomes.
Master's degree in healthcare administration, Clinical Laboratory Science, or other related field.

cond_0088.intro: This role assists the Laboratory Director and Medical Directors in managing personnel and operations of the Clinical Pathology Laboratory, including the Reference Laboratory, Essential Services Laboratory, Physician Office Laboratories, and Patient Service Centers. The position oversees both technical and non-technical Clinical Laboratory personnel and operations to ensure consistent quality of service to patients and clinicians.
cond_0088.responsibilities:
Supports the vision and goals of [Company name masked] and adheres to established best practices. Recruits, selects, and manages staff to demonstrate behaviors consistent with [Company name masked] beliefs and Core Values; acts as chief retention officer for area of responsibility.
Coordinates with Assistant Managers to ensure that meaningful leader/employee rounding is completed according to span of control expectations.
Coordinates all phases of orientation and training, including technical compliance and safety in accordance with all regulatory requirements for technical team members and students.
Develops, implements, and analyzes adherence to organizational and service/department-specific standards of care, policies, and procedures.
Conducts timely staff performance appraisals ensuring staff competence while emphasizing staff retention strategies through coaching and individual development.
Ensures adequate staff scheduling within the department to maintain quality patient care and meet productivity benchmarks.
Maintains productivity benchmarks and identifies continuous improvement opportunities in operations and utilization of resources.
Provides educational opportunities for technical staff and supports application of those skills.
Accountable for quality of patient care, physician satisfaction, and employee satisfaction; supports a multi-disciplinary approach to interdepartmental problem solving.
Coordinates with other departments to support efficient and effective patient-centered care delivery.
Ensures knowledgeable service to patients, staff, and visitors; updates and informs staff on appropriate patient care, client service, and laboratory issues as needed.
Coordinates with laboratory management to address and resolve operational issues.
Ensures staff compliance with all hospital, state, OSHA, College of American Pathologists (CAP), and AABB regulations for all facilities; supports preparation and participation in CAP and AABB inspections.
Coordinates with laboratory leadership to ensure high complexity testing in all sections is conducted in accordance with policies, procedures, regulatory, and safety requirements.
Ensures adequate and appropriate supplies are available for employee safety.
Participates in the departmental budgetary process to support proper operational planning.
Maintains professional development through seminars, workshops, and professional affiliations to stay current on trends in personnel management and the field.
Participates in and/or leads meetings, committees, strategic planning, and lean projects as assigned.
Performs other related projects and duties as assigned.
cond_0088.requirements:
Knowledge of clinical laboratory test protocols, equipment, and processes.
Knowledge of organizational and human resource management standards and practices.
Knowledge of management and leadership principles and practices.
Knowledge of computer hardware equipment and software applications relevant to work functions.
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with all levels of personnel and medical staff.
Ability to develop written policies and procedures, memoranda, and performance evaluations with measurable behaviors.
Ability to problem solve and apply independent critical thinking skills.
Ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams and function as a team member.
Ability to maintain confidentiality relevant to sensitive information.
Ability to prioritize work demands and work with minimal supervision.
Ability to conduct crucial conversations with desired outcomes.
Ability to make operational and management decisions in response to changing conditions.
Ability to be available for technical issues daily and during after hours, holidays, and weekends.
Ability to maintain regular and punctual attendance.
Bachelor of Science or Allied Health degree required.
Master's degree in healthcare administration, Clinical Laboratory Science, or other related field preferred.
Five (5) years previous supervisory experience in a clinical laboratory and managerial experience in a clinical laboratory required.
MLS(ASCP)CM certification required.

cond_0149.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Knowledge of clinical laboratory test protocols, equipment, and processes.
Knowledge of organizational and human resource management standards and practices.
Knowledge of management and leadership principles and practices.
Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with all levels of personnel and medical staff.
Ability to problem solve and engage independent critical thinking skills.
Ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams and work as a team member.
Ability to maintain confidentiality relevant to sensitive information.
Ability to prioritize work demands and work with minimal supervision.
Ability to make operational and management decisions in response to changing conditions.
Ability to be available for technical issues daily and during after hours, holidays and weekends.

Five (5) years previous supervisory experience in a clinical laboratory and managerial experience in a clinical laboratory.
MLS(ASCP)CM certification.

Knowledge of computer hardware equipment and software applications relevant to work functions.
Ability to develop written policies and procedures, memoranda, and performance evaluations with measurable behaviors.

cond_0256.intro: Assists the Laboratory Director and Medical Directors in managing personnel and daily operations of the Clinical Pathology Laboratory, including the Reference Laboratory, Essential Services Laboratory, Physician Office Laboratories and Patient Service Centers. Oversees both technical and non-technical Clinical Laboratory personnel and operations to ensure the highest quality of service to patients and clinicians at all times. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp clinical laboratory operations and the regulatory environment that comes with them.
cond_0256.responsibilities: Supports the vision and goals of [Company name masked] and adheres to established best practices (AIDET, Rounding, thank you notes, 5/10 Rule, etc.). Recruits, selects, and manages staff to demonstrate behaviors consistent with [Company name masked] beliefs and [Company name masked] Core Values; acts as chief retention officer for area of responsibility. Works collaboratively with the Assistant Managers to ensure that meaningful leader/employee rounding is completed according to span of control expectations. Coordinates all phases of orientation and training, including technical compliance and safety in accordance with all regulatory requirements for technical team members and students. Develops, implements, and analyzes adherence to organizational and service/department specific standards of care and policies and procedures. Conducts timely staff performance appraisals ensuring staff competence while emphasizing staff retention strategies through coaching and individual development. Ensures adequate staff scheduling within the department to ensure quality patient care and meet productivity benchmarks. Maintains productivity benchmarks and looks for continuous improvement in operations and utilization of resources. Provides and encourages educational opportunities and application of those skills for technical staff. Accountable for quality of patient care, physician satisfaction and employee satisfaction; facilitates a multi-disciplinary and collaborative approach to interdepartmental problem solving. Promotes interdisciplinary and interdepartmental collaboration to optimize efficient and effective patient-centered care delivery. Ensures courteous, knowledgeable service to patients, staff, and visitors; continually updates and educates staff on appropriate patient care, client service and laboratory issues. Collaborates with laboratory management to resolve management and operational issues. Ensures staff compliance with all hospital, state, OSHA, College of American Pathologists (CAP) and AABB regulations for all facilities and supports coordination, preparation, and participation in CAP and AABB inspections for all facilities. Collaborates with laboratory leadership to ensure the performance of high complexity testing in all sections is in accordance with policies, procedures, regulatory and safety requirements. Ensures adequate and appropriate supplies are used for employee safety. Participates in and supports the departmental budgetary procedure to ensure proper operational and planning. Maintains professional growth and development through seminars, workshops, and professional affiliations to keep abreast of latest trends in personnel management and field of expertise. Participates in and/or leads meetings, committees, strategic planning and lean projects as assigned. Performs other related projects and duties as assigned.

You will regularly engage with both technical and non-technical Clinical Laboratory personnel and operations to ensure the highest quality of service to patients and clinicians at all times.
cond_0330.responsibilities: Supports the vision and goals of [Company name masked] and adheres to established best practices (AIDET, Rounding, thank you notes, 5/10 Rule, etc.). Recruits, selects, and manages staff to demonstrate behaviors consistent with [Company name masked] beliefs and [Company name masked] Core Values; acts as chief retention officer for area of responsibility. Works collaboratively and regularly with the Assistant Managers to ensure that meaningful leader/employee rounding is completed according to span of control expectations. Coordinates all phases of orientation and training, including technical compliance and safety in accordance with all regulatory requirements for technical team members and students. Develops, implements, and analyzes adherence to organizational and service/department specific standards of care and policies and procedures. Conducts timely staff performance appraisals ensuring staff competence while emphasizing staff retention strategies through coaching and individual development. Ensures adequate staff scheduling within the department to ensure quality patient care and meet productivity benchmarks. Maintains productivity benchmarks and looks for continuous improvement in operations and utilization of resources. Provides and encourages educational opportunities and application of those skills for technical staff. Accountable for quality of patient care, physician satisfaction and employee satisfaction; actively facilitates a multi-disciplinary and collaborative approach to interdepartmental problem solving. Promotes interdisciplinary and interdepartmental collaboration to optimize efficient and effective patient-centered care delivery. Ensures courteous, knowledgeable service to patients, staff, and visitors; continually connects with and educates staff on appropriate patient care, client service and laboratory issues. Collaborates daily with laboratory management to resolve management and operational issues. Ensures staff compliance with all hospital, state, OSHA, College of American Pathologists (CAP) and AABB regulations for all facilities and actively supports coordination, preparation, and participation in CAP and AABB inspections for all facilities. Collaborates with laboratory leadership to ensure the performance of high complexity testing in all sections is in accordance with policies, procedures, regulatory and safety requirements. Ensures adequate and appropriate supplies are used for employee safety. Participates in and supports the departmental budgetary procedure to ensure proper operational and planning. Maintains professional growth and development through seminars, workshops, and professional affiliations to keep abreast of latest trends in personnel management and field of expertise. Participates in and/or leads meetings, committees, strategic planning and lean projects as assigned. Performs other related projects and duties as assigned.
cond_0330.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Knowledge of clinical laboratory test protocols, equipment, and processes.
Knowledge of organizational and human resource management standards and practices.
Knowledge of management and leadership principles and practices.
Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing, including regular interaction with personnel and medical staff at all levels.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with all levels of personnel and medical staff.
Ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams and actively contribute as a team member.
Ability to problem solve and engage independent critical thinking skills.
Ability to perform crucial conversations with desired outcomes.
Ability to make operational and management decisions in response to changing conditions.
Ability to be available for technical issues daily and during after hours, holidays and weekends.
Ability to maintain regular and punctual attendance.
Bachelor of Science or Allied Health degree.
Five (5) years previous supervisory experience in a clinical laboratory and managerial experience in a clinical laboratory.
MLS(ASCP)CM certification.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of computer hardware equipment and software applications relevant to work functions.
Ability to develop written policies and procedures, memoranda, and performance evaluations with measurable behaviors.
Ability to maintain confidentiality relevant to sensitive information.
Ability to prioritize work demands and work with minimal supervision.
Master's degree in healthcare administration, Clinical Laboratory Science or other related field.

This role works alongside the Laboratory Director and Medical Directors to support personnel management and daily operations of the Clinical Pathology Laboratory, including the Reference Laboratory, Essential Services Laboratory, Physician Office Laboratories, and Patient Service Centers. The role shares oversight of both technical and non-technical Clinical Laboratory personnel and operations to help ensure consistent, high-quality service to patients and clinicians.
cond_0414.responsibilities:
Supports the vision and goals of [Company name masked] and adheres to established best practices (AIDET, Rounding, thank you notes, 5/10 Rule, etc.).
Coordinates with the team on recruiting, selecting, and managing staff to demonstrate behaviors consistent with [Company name masked] beliefs and [Company name masked] Core Values; acts as chief retention officer for area of responsibility.
Works collaboratively with the Assistant Managers to ensure that meaningful leader/employee rounding is completed according to span of control expectations.
Coordinates all phases of orientation and training, including technical compliance and safety in accordance with all regulatory requirements for technical team members and students.
Works with the team to develop, implement, and analyze adherence to organizational and service/department specific standards of care and policies and procedures.
Conducts timely staff performance appraisals ensuring staff competence while emphasizing staff retention strategies through coaching and individual development.
Coordinates adequate staff scheduling within the department to ensure quality patient care and meet productivity benchmarks.
Maintains productivity benchmarks and works with colleagues to identify continuous improvement in operations and utilization of resources.
Provides and encourages educational opportunities and application of those skills for technical staff.
Shares accountability for quality of patient care, physician satisfaction, and employee satisfaction; facilitates a multi-disciplinary and collaborative approach to interdepartmental problem solving.
Promotes interdisciplinary and interdepartmental collaboration to optimize efficient and effective patient-centered care delivery.
Ensures courteous, knowledgeable service to patients, staff, and visitors; continually updates and educates staff on appropriate patient care, client service, and laboratory issues.
Coordinates with laboratory management to resolve management and operational issues.
Ensures staff compliance with all hospital, state, OSHA, College of American Pathologists (CAP) and AABB regulations for all facilities and supports coordination, preparation, and participation in CAP and AABB inspections for all facilities.
Works alongside laboratory leadership to ensure the performance of high complexity testing in all sections is in accordance with policies, procedures, regulatory and safety requirements.
Ensures adequate and appropriate supplies are used for employee safety.
Participates in and supports the departmental budgetary procedure to ensure proper operational and planning.
Maintains professional growth and development through seminars, workshops, and professional affiliations to keep abreast of latest trends in personnel management and field of expertise.
Participates in and/or leads meetings, committees, strategic planning, and lean projects as assigned.
Performs other related projects and duties as assigned.

cond_0505.responsibilities: Supports the vision and goals of [Company name masked] and adheres to established best practices (AIDET, Rounding, thank you notes, 5/10 Rule, etc.). Recruits, selects, and manages staff to demonstrate behaviors consistent with [Company name masked] beliefs and [Company name masked] Core Values; acts as chief retention officer for area of responsibility. Works collaboratively with the Assistant Managers to ensure that meaningful leader/employee rounding is completed according to span of control expectations. Coordinates all phases of orientation and training, including technical compliance and safety in accordance with all regulatory requirements for technical team members and students. Develops, implements, and analyzes adherence to organizational and service/department specific standards of care and policies and procedures. Conducts timely staff performance appraisals ensuring staff competence while emphasizing staff retention strategies through coaching and individual development. Ensures adequate staff scheduling within the department to ensure quality patient care and meet productivity benchmarks. Maintains productivity benchmarks and looks for continuous improvement in operations and utilization of resources. Provides and encourages educational opportunities and application of those skills for technical staff. Accountable for quality of patient care, physician satisfaction and employee satisfaction; facilitates a multi-disciplinary and collaborative approach to interdepartmental problem solving. Promotes interdisciplinary and interdepartmental collaboration to optimize efficient and effective patient-centered care delivery. Ensures courteous, knowledgeable service to patients, staff, and visitors; continually updates and educates staff on appropriate patient care, client service and laboratory issues. Collaborates with laboratory management to resolve management and operational issues. Ensures staff compliance with all hospital, state, OSHA, College of American Pathologists (CAP) and AABB regulations for all facilities and supports coordination, preparation, and participation in CAP and AABB inspections for all facilities. Collaborates with laboratory leadership to ensure the performance of high complexity testing in all sections is in accordance with policies, procedures, regulatory and safety requirements. Ensures adequate and appropriate supplies are used for employee safety. Participates in and supports the departmental budgetary procedure to ensure proper operational and planning. Maintains professional growth and development through seminars, workshops, and professional affiliations to keep abreast of latest trends in personnel management and field of expertise. Participates in and/or leads meetings, committees, strategic planning and lean projects as assigned. Performs other related projects and duties as assigned.
cond_0505.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor of Science or Allied Health degree
MLS(ASCP)CM certification
Five (5) years previous supervisory experience in a clinical laboratory and managerial experience in a clinical laboratory
Knowledge of clinical laboratory test protocols, equipment, and processes
Knowledge of organizational and human resource management standards and practices
Knowledge of management and leadership principles and practices
Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with all levels of personnel and medical staff
Ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams and work as a team member
Ability to problem solve and engage independent critical thinking skills
Ability to prioritize work demands and work with minimal supervision
Ability to make operational and management decisions in response to changing conditions
Ability to be available for technical issues daily and during after hours, holidays and weekends
Ability to maintain regular and punctual attendance
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree in healthcare administration, Clinical Laboratory Science or other related field
Knowledge of computer hardware equipment and software applications relevant to work functions
Ability to develop written policies and procedures, memoranda, and performance evaluations with measurable behaviors
Ability to maintain confidentiality relevant to sensitive information
Ability to perform crucial conversations with desired outcomes
cond_0505.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0505.workplace_support: We are committed to creating a workplace where people can grow, connect, and build their careers with confidence. Employees have access to knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and career-development resources designed to support growth over time.

cond_0624.responsibilities: Supports the vision and goals of [Company name masked] and adheres to established best practices (AIDET, Rounding, thank you notes, 5/10 Rule, etc.). Works collaboratively with the Assistant Managers to ensure that meaningful leader/employee rounding is completed according to span of control expectations. Coordinates all phases of orientation and training, including technical compliance and safety in accordance with all regulatory requirements for technical team members and students. Conducts timely staff performance appraisals ensuring staff competence while emphasizing staff retention strategies through coaching and individual development. Provides and encourages educational opportunities and application of those skills for technical staff. Accountable for quality of patient care, physician satisfaction and employee satisfaction; facilitates a multi-disciplinary and collaborative approach to interdepartmental problem solving. Collaborates with laboratory management to resolve management and operational issues. Ensures staff compliance with all hospital, state, OSHA, College of American Pathologists (CAP) and AABB regulations for all facilities and supports coordination, preparation, and participation in CAP and AABB inspections for all facilities. Collaborates with laboratory leadership to ensure the performance of high complexity testing in all sections is in accordance with policies, procedures, regulatory and safety requirements. Ensures adequate and appropriate supplies are used for employee safety. Participates in and supports the departmental budgetary procedure to ensure proper operational and planning. Maintains professional growth and development through seminars, workshops, and professional affiliations to keep abreast of latest trends in personnel management and field of expertise. Participates in and/or leads meetings, committees, strategic planning and lean projects as assigned. Performs other related projects and duties as assigned.
cond_0641.requirements: Advanced knowledge of clinical laboratory test protocols, equipment, and processes. Deep knowledge of organizational and human resource management standards and practices. Strong independent critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Proven ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams and function effectively as a team member. Ability to maintain confidentiality relevant to sensitive information. Ability to prioritize work demands and work with minimal supervision. Ability to perform crucial conversations with desired outcomes. Ability to make sound operational and management decisions in response to changing conditions. Ability to be available for technical issues daily and during after hours, holidays and weekends. Ability to maintain regular and punctual attendance. Bachelor of Science or Allied Health degree required; advanced degree in healthcare administration, Clinical Laboratory Science, or other related field strongly preferred. Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in supervisory and managerial roles within a clinical laboratory required. MLS(ASCP)CM certification required.
